scripts.dev:admin: pnpm run prepare:shared && pnpm --dir admin dev:ele
scripts.build:admin: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --dir admin build:ele
scripts.test:e2e:admin: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --dir admin --filter @vben/web-ele test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm test:e2e:web && pnpm test:e2e:admin && pnpm test:e2e:uni
scripts.check:api-drift: pnpm run api:generate && git diff --exit-code -- shared/src/types/api.gen.ts
scripts.check:capabilities-drift: pnpm run generate:capabilities && git diff --exit-code -- shared/src/constants/capabilities.gen.ts
scripts.lint:all: pnpm run check:no-empty-catch && pnpm run check:dependency-compat && pnpm run check:vue-ui-contracts && pnpm lint:web && pnpm lint:admin
scripts.lint: pnpm run check:no-empty-catch && pnpm run lint:web
scripts.test:uni: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter @stuhelper/uniappx exec vitest run
scripts.test:all: pnpm run check:dependency-compat && pnpm --filter @stuhelper/web test && pnpm run test:shared && pnpm run test:uni && pnpm run test:admin
scripts.type-check:web: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter @stuhelper/web type-check && pnpm --filter @stuhelper/shared type-check
scripts.type-check:admin: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --dir admin check:type
scripts.type-check:all: pnpm type-check:web && pnpm type-check:uni && pnpm type-check:admin
scripts.type-check: pnpm run type-check:web && pnpm run type-check:uni
